source.드시는 약, 드셔도 되는지 확인: Check if you can take your medicines
source.잡곡밥 · 현미 · 검은쌀: Multigrain rice · Brown rice · Black rice
Do not eat multigrain rice, brown rice, or black rice.
source.그릇에 담긴 잡곡밥 사진: Photo of multigrain rice in a bowl
Do not eat kimchi, namul (seasoned greens), or bean sprouts, either.
source.접시에 담긴 김치와 콩나물무침 사진: Photo of kimchi and seasoned bean sprouts on a plate
Do not eat gim, miyeok, kelp, or mushrooms, either.
source.접시에 담긴 구운 김과 미역 사진: Photo of roasted gim and miyeok seaweed on a plate
Do not eat fruit with seeds, either. This means watermelon, Korean melon, strawberries, grapes, and kiwi.
source.접시에 담긴 수박, 딸기, 포도 사진: Photo of watermelon, strawberries, and grapes on a plate
Do not eat chili seeds, corn, or nuts, either.
You can eat white rice and white rice porridge.
source.그릇에 담긴 흰죽 사진: Photo of white rice porridge in a bowl
Eggs, tofu, and muk (Korean jelly) are okay, too.
source.접시에 담긴 삶은 계란과 두부 사진: Photo of boiled eggs and tofu on a plate
You can eat apples, pears, and bananas, too.
source.접시에 담긴 바나나와 사과 사진: Photo of bananas and apples on a plate
Broth, bread, clear drinks, and potatoes are okay, too.
From 3 days before the test, do not eat these foods.
source.잡곡밥 · 현미 · 검은쌀 — 안 돼요: Multigrain rice · Brown rice · Black rice — No
source.국물 · 빵 · 맑은 음료 · 감자 — 괜찮아요: Broth · Bread · Clear drinks · Potatoes — Okay
The evening before the test, eat dinner before 7 PM.
Eat only white rice porridge. Do not eat side dishes.
Do not put grains, walnuts, pine nuts, or sesame in the porridge.
source.잡곡·호두·잣·깨는 빼요: No grains, walnuts, pine nuts, or sesame
source.약과 물은 안내 시간대로: Medicine and water at the given times
Do not eat food from 12 midnight.
Take medicine and water at the times we gave you.
source.약과 물은 안내 시간대로 드세요: Take medicine and water at the given times
source.대변 검사가 있는 분: If you have a stool test
source.못 받아도 약은 그대로: No stool? Still take the medicine
Collect your stool before you take the medicine.
If you cannot collect stool, still take the medicine.
source.못 받아도 약은 드세요: No stool? Still take the medicine
Put 1 packet of A and 1 packet of B in the 1L bottle.
Pour bottled water up to the line.
Shake it well until it dissolves.
source.A제 1포 + B제 1포: 1 packet of A + 1 packet of B
source.1L 통 표시선까지 생수: Water up to the line on the 1L bottle
Take the first medicine at 9~10 PM the night before the test.
Drink the 1L of medicine in 4 parts. Drink 1 part every 15 minutes. This takes 1 hour.
source.15분마다 1번, 모두 4번: 1 time every 15 minutes, 4 times in all
Take the second medicine at 4~5 AM on the test day.
Drink it the same way as the first medicine.
Also take 1 packet of Gasocol liquid with it.
source.혈압약은 물 한두 모금과 함께: Blood pressure pill with 1 or 2 sips of water
From 5 AM on the test day, do not eat or drink anything.
No water, medicine, gum, breath mints, or cigarettes.
But take your blood pressure pill with 1 or 2 sips of water.
source.껌, 은단, 담배도 안 돼요: No gum, breath mints, or cigarettes
source.생리 중이면 약을 드시지 마세요: On your period? Do not take the medicine
source.임신·수유 중이면 먼저 확인해 주세요: Pregnant or breastfeeding? Check with us first
If you have your period, do not take the medicine.
If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, check with us first.
source.토를 심하게 하면 약을 멈추고 센터에 전화하세요: Throwing up a lot? Stop the medicine. Call the center
source.변을 충분히 못 봤거나 약 시간·양을 못 지켰으면 검사 날 접수 직원에게: Not enough stool came out? Or you missed the medicine time or amount? Tell the front desk on the test day
If you throw up a lot, stop the medicine. Then call the center.
source.변을 충분히 못 봤거나 약 시간·양을 못 지켰으면: Not enough stool came out? Or you missed the medicine time or amount?
Then tell the front desk on the test day.
On the test day, come with a caregiver.
source.검사 전날 저녁 흰죽은\n몇 시 전에 드실까요?:
The evening before the test,
by what time do you eat porridge?
eat only porridge before 7 PM. Do not eat side dishes.
source.검사 전날 저녁이에요.\n드실 수 있는 것은?:
It is the evening before the test.
What can you eat?
source.만든 약 1L는\n어떻게 드실까요?:
How do you drink
the 1L of medicine?
in 4 parts, every 15 minutes. This takes 1 hour.
source.약을 처음 마시고\n15분이 지났어요. 어떻게 할까요?:
You drank the first part.
15 minutes have passed. What do you do?
source.남은 약을 한 번에 마셔요: Drink the rest all at once
source.검사 날 새벽 5시 이후\n먹어도 되는 것은?:
On the test day, after 5 AM,
what can you take?
source.검사 날 새벽 6시예요.\n목이 말라요. 물을 마셔도 될까요?:
It is 6 AM on the test day.
You are thirsty. Can you drink water?
source.약 먹기 전에\n생리를 시작했다면?:
Your period started
before the medicine. What do you do?
source.두 번째 약 먹을 시간이에요.\n생리 중이에요. 어떻게 할까요?:
It is time for the second medicine.
You have your period. What do you do?
source.1교시 · 3일 전 피할 음식: Class 1 · Foods to avoid for 3 days
source.검사 3일 전부터 이 음식은 안 돼요: No to these foods from 3 days before
There are foods you must not eat from 3 days before the test.
From 3 days before the test, do not eat these foods.
Well done! Now let's learn foods you can eat.
source.이번에는 드셔도 되는 음식을 볼까요?: Now, let's see foods you can eat.
These foods are okay to eat before the test.
Well done! Today's class is over.
source.잡곡밥, 김치, 김, 씨 있는 과일은 드시지 마세요: Do not eat multigrain rice, kimchi, gim, or fruit with seeds
From 3 days before the test, do not eat multigrain rice, kimchi, gim, or fruit with seeds.
source.음식은 밤 12시부터 금지, 약과 물은 안내 시간대로: No food from 12 midnight. Take medicine and water at the given times.
For dinner, eat only porridge before 7 PM. Your first medicine is at 9 PM.
source.새벽 5시부터는 물도 드시지 마세요. 단, 혈압약은 물 한두 모금과 함께: From 5 AM, do not drink even water. But take your blood pressure pill with 1 or 2 sips of water.
source.궁금한 점은 병원에 물어보세요: Ask the hospital if you have questions
source.검사날 아침\n혈압약 먹어요?:
On the test day morning,
do you take your blood pressure pill?
source.검사날 아침 안 먹어요: Do not take it on the test day morning
source.검사날 아침\n당뇨약 먹어요?:
On the test day morning,
do you take your diabetes medicine?
source.전날 저녁 주사 → 간호사 확인: Shot the evening before → Ask your nurse
source.검사날 아침 주사 안 돼요: No shot on the test day morning
source.인슐린은\n누구 말대로 해요?:
For insulin,
who do you listen to?
source.혼자 끊으면 안 돼요: Do not stop it on your own
source.검사 2주 전 의사 상담: Talk to your doctor 2 weeks before the test
source.이 약,\n혼자 끊어도 돼요?:
Can you stop this medicine
on your own?
source.검사 일주일 전,\n한약 먹어요?:
1 week before the test,
do you take herbal medicine?
source.모르는 약,\n병원에 전화해요?:
Not sure about a medicine?
Do you call the hospital?
